info.name: Get paystubs from legal entity integrated with external benefits vendor

params.name: legal_entity_id
params.description: Id from the legal entity to fetch data

params.name: states
params.description: Payroll states: OPEN | LOCKED | CLOSED (OPEN doesn't have `employees` info)

params.name: date_start
params.description: Start date to fectch the paystubs from

params.name: date_end
params.description: End date to fectch the paystubs

params.name: cursor
params.description: The last fetched id to start querying from

items.docs:
Returns paginated paystubs for a legal entity that is integrated with an external benefits vendor. Results can be filtered by payroll state and date range; paystubs in the `OPEN` state do not include employee-level detail.
 **Token scopes**: `benefits:read`
